body:
Confirmed live both extension 1000 (native) and 1000web (webphone) now register successfully server-side (200 OK) after the AOR fix. Founder's phone still failed to register over cellular data specifically -- consistent with a previously-documented, separate finding that raw UDP SIP is blocked somewhere on the mobile network path, outside this server. Embedded the already-real, already-verified standalone webphone.html/webphone.js (JsSIP over wss://) into the console's SIP Phone page via a same-origin iframe. Deployed live (static-only). Commit ba3d852.

⚓ ☃
title: Embedded the browser Web Phone into the console's SIP Phone page (fallback for blocked raw UDP SIP on mobile)
